description: Defines data transfer object (DTO) classes for product creation and update requests in a product management API. The classes include validation attributes and are part of the Models namespace in the Product Management backend.

classes.name: CreateProductRequest
classes.description: DTO for creating a new product, includes properties for name, price, and quantity with validation attributes.

classes.name: UpdateProductRequest
classes.description: DTO for updating an existing product, includes properties for name, price, and quantity with validation attributes.
